description:
Change a stored customer.

Only the fields you send are changed — omit one to leave it alone, send
`null` to clear it. Documents already issued keep the details they were
issued with; this does not rewrite them.

ElectronicAddress.description:
BT-34 / BT-49 — where a document is routed on Peppol or DBNA.

Both halves are required: an identifier without its scheme cannot be
resolved, because the same string means different things in different code
lists. This is not the tax id, which identifies a company to a tax
authority rather than a mailbox on a network.

scheme_id.description: EAS code list identifier — 0088 is GLN, 9930 a German VAT number.
scheme_id.title: Scheme Id
